title: Eradu Nakshatragalu
desc: A chance encounter between a poor boy and a prince, who are strikingly similar in appearance, prompts them to exchange lives.

title: Obbalu Laila Goskara
desc: After returning from a world tour, a man comes across a woman and falls in love with her. However, she has no interest in him and rejects his proposal.

title: Naa Saami Ranga
desc: A man gains great notoriety in his village for his unmatched strength and brutal nature, which makes him a target of antisocial elements with a ruthless agenda.

title: Ananda Nilaya
desc: A man in debt is in desperate need of money and wants to sell a house he has in the city. But first he must deal with a stubborn tenant family that refuses to leave the house despite his best efforts.

title: Thandege Thakka Maga
desc: Sathya is forced to marry a woman from a lower caste after his father's sudden death. He struggles to lead a happy marital life while dealing with certain problems.
